paper_000.title: Photovoltaic Hall effect in graphene
key_contributions: Floquet formalism for AC electric fields in solids
Prediction of photo-induced DC Hall current in graphene
Berry curvature expression in terms of Floquet states
paper_000.relevance_to_task: Theoretical foundation for Floquet engineering in graphene

paper_001.title: Observation of Floquet-Bloch states on the surface of a topological insulator
key_contributions: First experimental observation of Floquet-Bloch states via tr-ARPES
Replica bands spaced by pump photon energy (120 meV)
Polarization-dependent band gaps at avoided crossings
paper_001.relevance_to_task: Experimental precedent and methodology for tr-ARPES detection of Floquet states

paper_002.title: Creating stable Floquet-Weyl semimetals by laser-driving of 3D Dirac materials
key_contributions: Floquet-Weyl semimetal creation via circular polarization
paper_002.relevance_to_task: Extension of Floquet engineering to 3D Dirac materials

paper_003.title: Theory of Floquet band formation and local pseudospin textures in pump-probe photoemission of graphene
key_contributions: Theory of Floquet band formation in graphene under realistic pulses
Local spectral gaps and pseudospin texture analysis
Hierarchy of time scales: sigma_pump > sigma_probe >> 2pi*hbar/Omega
paper_003.relevance_to_task: Direct theoretical framework for interpreting graphene tr-ARPES data in low-frequency regime

methodological_implications.expected_replica_spacing: Integer multiples of pump photon energy hbar*omega
methodological_implications.polarization_signatures: Circular polarization breaks TRS and opens Dirac gap; linear polarization shows weaker anisotropy
methodological_implications.low_frequency_regime: Overlapping sidebands prevent global topological classification but local gaps remain observable
methodological_implications.distinguishing_Floquet_from_LAPE: Initial-state Floquet replicas show band gaps at crossings; LAPE bands do not
